Turf functions mapgl support three input methods: existing map layer source references (layer_id), sf objects (data), raw coordinates available - giving flexibility structure spatial workflows.

title: Client-side geospatial analysis with turf.js
text: turf_buffer() function creates buffer zones around features. useful proximity analysis, creating catchment areas, adding visual emphasis around points interest.
code: library(mapgl) library(sf) library(tigris) options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)  # Create a point for Texas Christian University tcu <- st_sf(   name = "TCU",   geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(-97.364, 32.708)), crs = 4326) )  # Create a map with TCU and a 2-mile buffer maplibre(style = carto_style("positron"),           center = c(-97.364, 32.708),           zoom = 11) |>   # TCU location   add_circle_layer(     id = "tcu",     source = tcu,     circle_color = "purple",     circle_radius = 8,     circle_stroke_color = "white",     circle_stroke_width = 2   ) |>   # Create 2-mile buffer around TCU   turf_buffer(     layer_id = "tcu",     radius = 2,     units = "miles",     source_id = "tcu_buffer"   ) |>   # Style the buffer   add_fill_layer(     id = "buffer_display",     source = "tcu_buffer",      fill_color = "purple",     fill_opacity = 0.2,     fill_outline_color = "purple"   )

title: Client-side geospatial analysis with turf.js
text: One powerful features turf_filter(), lets filter features based spatial relationships. supports five spatial predicates: intersects: Features overlap touch within: Features completely inside others contains: Features completely contain others crosses: Features cross boundaries disjoint: Features don’t touch Note can chain together turf operations; layer_id argument supports either source layer IDs map, don’t necessarily need visualize sources using spatial analysis.
code: # Find Census tracts that intersect with TCU's 2-mile buffer tarrant_tracts <- tracts("TX", "Tarrant", cb = TRUE)  maplibre(style = carto_style("positron")) |>   fit_bounds(tarrant_tracts) |>   # All Census tracts   add_fill_layer(     id = "all_tracts",     source = tarrant_tracts,     fill_color = "lightgray",     fill_opacity = 0.5,     fill_outline_color = "white"   ) |>   # TCU buffer as filter geometry   turf_buffer(     data = tcu,     radius = 2,     units = "miles",     source_id = "tcu_buffer_filter"   ) |>    # Find tracts that intersect with the buffer   turf_filter(     layer_id = "all_tracts",     filter_layer_id = "tcu_buffer_filter",     predicate = "intersects",     source_id = "intersecting_tracts"   ) |>   # Highlight the results   add_fill_layer(     id = "intersects_result",     source = "intersecting_tracts",     fill_color = "red",     fill_opacity = 0.8   ) |>   # Show TCU location   add_circle_layer(     id = "tcu_location",     source = tcu,     circle_color = "purple",     circle_radius = 10,     circle_stroke_color = "white",     circle_stroke_width = 3   ) |>    add_fill_layer(     id = "buffer_display",     source = "tcu_buffer_filter",     fill_color = "purple",     fill_opacity = 0.2   )

code: library(shiny) library(mapgl) library(sf) library(tigris)  tarrant_tracts <- tracts(state = "TX", county = "Tarrant", cb = TRUE)  ui <- fluidPage(   maplibreOutput("map", height = "100vh"),      absolutePanel(     top = 10, left = 10,     selectInput("predicate", "Filter Type:",                 choices = c("Intersects" = "intersects",                             "Within" = "within",                              "Contains" = "contains",                             "Disjoint" = "disjoint"),                 selected = "intersects"),          verbatimTextOutput("results")   ) )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   output$map <- renderMaplibre({     maplibre(style = carto_style("positron")) |>       fit_bounds(tarrant_tracts) |>       add_fill_layer(         id = "tracts",         source = tarrant_tracts,         fill_color = "lightblue",         fill_opacity = 0.5,         fill_outline_color = "white"       ) |>       add_draw_control(position = "top-right")   })      # Real-time filtering when user draws   observeEvent(input$map_drawn_features, {     if (!is.null(input$map_drawn_features)) {       # Debounce slightly to allow the source to load       Sys.sleep(0.2)       maplibre_proxy("map") |>         turf_filter(           layer_id = "tracts",           filter_layer_id = "gl-draw-polygon-fill.cold",           predicate = input$predicate,           source_id = "filtered_tracts",           input_id = "filter_results"         ) |>         add_fill_layer(           id = "filtered",           source = "filtered_tracts",            fill_color = "red",           fill_opacity = 0.8         )     }   })      output$results <- renderText({     if (!is.null(input$map_turf_filter_results)) {       paste("Found", length(input$map_turf_filter_results$result$features), "Census tracts")     }   }) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

text: complex spatial analysis, can combine multiple turf operations. turf_intersect() function returns actual intersection geometry - overlapping area features: get buffer “Venn diagram” shows us areas near points interest.
code: # Create two overlapping buffer zones around different Fort Worth locations downtown_fw <- st_sf(geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(-97.3313, 32.7548)), crs = 4326))  # Downtown cultural_district <- st_sf(geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(-97.3632, 32.7494)), crs = 4326))  # Cultural District  maplibre(style = carto_style("positron"),           center = c(-97.3313, 32.7548), zoom = 12) |>   # Create overlapping buffers   turf_buffer(data = downtown_fw, radius = 1.5, units = "miles", source_id = "downtown_buffer") |>   turf_buffer(data = cultural_district, radius = 1.5, units = "miles", source_id = "cultural_buffer") |>   # Show original buffer areas   add_fill_layer(id = "downtown", source = "downtown_buffer", fill_color = "red", fill_opacity = 0.3) |>   add_fill_layer(id = "cultural", source = "cultural_buffer", fill_color = "blue", fill_opacity = 0.3) |>   # Calculate the intersection - returns the overlapping geometry   turf_intersect(     layer_id = "downtown_buffer",     layer_id_2 = "cultural_buffer",      source_id = "intersection_result"   ) |>   # Show the intersection area   add_fill_layer(     id = "intersection",     source = "intersection_result",     fill_color = "green",     fill_opacity = 0.8   )

Legend with line patches for line layers add_categorical_legend(     map = map,     legend_title = "Road Type",     values = c("Highway", "Primary", "Secondary"),     colors = c("#000000", "#333333", "#666666"),     patch_shape = "line",     sizes = c(5, 3, 1)  # Line thickness in pixels )  # Legend with hexagon patches (e.g., for H3 data) add_categorical_legend(     map = map,     legend_title = "H3 Hexagon Categories",     values = c("Urban", "Suburban", "Rural"),     colors = c("#8B0000", "#FF6347", "#90EE90"),     patch_shape = "hexagon",     sizes = 25 )  # sf object automatically converted to SVG )  # For advanced users needing custom conversion options custom_svg <- mapgl:::.sf_to_svg(county_shape, simplify = TRUE,                                   tolerance = 0.001, fit_viewbox = TRUE) add_categorical_legend(     map = map,     legend_title = "Custom Converted Shape",     values = c("Type A"),     colors = c("#4169E1"),     patch_shape = custom_svg )  # text: CRAN release: 2026-06-20 Tooltips popups now accept {brace} templates package-wide. layer’s tooltip/popup (set_tooltip()/set_popup()) can take glue-style template "{name}: {population}", addition existing column name concat()/number_format() expression forms; substituted values HTML-escaped. New tooltip_style() / popup_style() helpers theme tooltips popups without hand-written HTML/CSS, mirroring legend_style(). Pass preset ("light"/"dark") custom appearance (background, border, radius, font, padding, shadow) new tooltip_style/popup_style argument layer functions (set_tooltip()/set_popup()). Tooltips unstyled default, existing maps unchanged. New add_flowmap() draws animated origin-destination flow maps powered Flowmap.gl (deck.gl). supports temporal flows, location clustering, customizable color schemes (flowmap_color_schemes()), CSS blend modes, themeable tooltips popups (per-object-type content via list(location = , flow = ), styled tooltip_style()/popup_style()). Flow filters settings can updated reactively Shiny set_flowmap_filter() set_flowmap_settings(), "window"-mode add_slider_control() can drive flowmap’s temporal range. heavy flow-mapping libraries load demand, maps without flowmap unaffected. Adapted Egor Kotov’s contribution #205, bundled bixi_locations bixi_flows datasets ready--use example. New add_slider_control() adds interactive slider filters /animates one layers numeric feature property. composes layer’s initial filter, later set_filter() calls, interactive legends (intersecting via ["", ...]) rather replacing . Modes "sequential" (one value), "cumulative" (everything value), "window" (selected range can also drive flowmap time ranges; window_behavior chooses "resizable" two-edge range "fixed"-width band pan). Two presentations: default "compact" slider, presentation = "timeline" — prominent, brushable histogram (drag selected window across bars, drag edges resize) modeled Egor Kotov’s FlowMapBlue time control (#205). Supports paint-property animation, optional play button, optional density histogram (histogram/histogram_data/counts, drawn d3 loaded demand). New slider_style() presets overrides control container, play button, track, thumb, histogram appearance, draggable = TRUE lets user reposition panel anywhere map (add_legend()). Companions update_slider_control() (Shiny proxies) as_time_property() (coerce Date/POSIXct numeric filter property) round feature. add_categorical_legend() add_legend() gain patch_spacing argument ("uniform"/"proportional"). "proportional", legend row’s height tracks symbol size, giving proportional vertical spacing graduated-symbol legends; default "uniform" preserves existing behavior (#206, thanks @mtennekes).  New add_h3t_source() adds tiled H3 (h3t) source MapLibre maps, fetching H3 cells current viewport {z}/{x}/{y} tile endpoint via h3tiles:// protocol — scalable alternative add_h3j_source() large datasets. Works multiple sources per map sides compare(). Bundled h3j-h3t library updated 0.9.7 (#199, thanks @bbest). Update MapLibre GL JS v5.24.0 Mapbox GL JS v3.24.0. Fixed add_legend() silently ignoring target argument MapLibre compare widgets: compare dispatch checked class "maplibre_compare" widget class "maplibregl_compare", legends attached regular map legends instead compare-level legends. compare() now supports synchronizing two maps (#204). Pass additional maps map1 map2 mode = "sync", control grid layout new ncol argument. Shiny, maps multi-map widgets addressed "map1" "mapN" via map_side compare proxy functions (integers also accepted, e.g. map_side = 3), emit input values like input$id_map3_view. Legends can targeted individual grid maps target = "map3". New bivariate mapping support bivariate_scale(), bivariate_palettes(), add_bivariate_legend(). Bivariate scales use 3--3 palettes, support custom 3--3 color matrices, optional x_breaks y_breaks stable bins, explicit na_color handling (#181). Continuous legends can now expose opt-color-ramp picker. Use color_ramps, selected_ramp, ramp_picker = TRUE continuous legends let readers switch palettes directly legend; named ramps display labels default, ramp_labels = FALSE creates compact picker. interpolate_palette() now carries additional scale metadata downstream legends, including source column, missing-value color, available color ramps, selected ramp. Compare maps now initialize legend interactivity assets supported dynamic legend features can used compare views. GitHub source archives now slimmed .gitattributes export-ignore rules generated site vignette assets. preserves GitHub Pages content repository avoiding large downloads GitHub-based package installs.

title: mapgl 0.4.6

New print_map() function provides capability use Quarto R Markdown documents. Update MapLibre GL JS v5.22.0 Mapbox GL JS v3.21.0. Mapbox GL JS v3.21.0 adds native PMTiles support via TileProvider API. add_pmtiles_source() now uses native vector tile path Mapbox, removing need custom PMTiles source implementation vector tiles. Support color tables categorical rasters add_image_source() (#21). New layer properties: circle_emissive_strength, circle_pitch_alignment, circle_pitch_scale, fill_pattern_cross_fade, line_elevation_reference, line_elevation_ground_scale, line_pattern_cross_fade, fill_extrusion_emissive_strength, fill_extrusion_ambient_occlusion_intensity, fill_extrusion_ambient_occlusion_radius, fill_extrusion_cast_shadows, fill_extrusion_cutoff_fade_range, fill_extrusion_vertical_gradient, raster_color, raster_color_mix, raster_color_range, raster_emissive_strength, icon_occlusion_opacity, text_occlusion_opacity. sfc geometry vectors now accepted wherever sf objects accepted, including layer functions, quickview functions, bounds parameter (#177). Various bug fixes performance improvements (see GitHub issues full list).
